title: Swarm
description: JSON Schema for a swarm instance: a parallel collection of characters coordinating through a shared cell-graph under a recognition discipline.

participants.description: Character slugs participating in the swarm.

coordinates-via.description: Reference to the shared cell-graph the participants read and write against.

recognition-discipline.description: Reference to the recognition-discipline rule-system that aggregates recognition cells into structural roles.

has-leader.description: Character slug currently bearing the leader role (derived from recognition cells).

engagement.description: Reference to the engagement record naming the swarm's purpose and termination condition.
